data.title: Bangkok Launches New Effort to Address Health Impacts of Extreme Heat
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) today announced the city will begin development of its Integrated and Evidence-Based Heat–Health Action Plan as part of Bangkok’s work with the Partnership for Healthy Cities—a global network of more than 70 cities committed to saving lives by preventing noncommunicable diseases (NCDs) and injuries. The initiative, launched in collaboration with the Asian Institute of Technology (AIT), will use scientific evidence to identify the neighborhoods where heat poses the greatest health risks, who is most vulnerable, and what measures can better protect residents.
